subject: maths
question: A man walks 600 m in 5 minutes. His speed (in km/h) is:
solution:
Given:

Distance traveled = 600 m 

Time taken = 5 min

Concept used:

Distance = Time × Speed 

1m/s = 18/5 km/h

Calculation:

5 min = 5 × 60 = 300 sec

His speed = 600/300 = 2 m/s

Now, his speed in km/h = 2 × 18/5 = 7.2 km/h

∴ His speed is 7.2 km/h.
